title: Products
description: Catalogue: prices per price list, colours with their images and stock

help.compare_price: Shown struck through if higher than the price
help.prices: Price for a group (price list) from a quantity. Without a row for a group, the general price with the group discount applies
help.images: The first one is the main image
help.colors: Each colour with its images: choosing a colour on the product page shows its photos. The surcharge is added to the price
help.slug: Part of the URL. Empty = generated from the name

confirm.duplicate: Duplicate this product? The copy will be unpublished.

validation.prices_duplicated: There are two prices for the same group and quantity
